Frequently Asked Questions

Is UET Taxila better than UHS?

Both University of Engineering & Technology Taxila and University of Health Sciences are HEC-recognized universities. UET Taxila is public (est. 1975) in Taxila, while UHS is public (est. 2002) in Lahore. The better choice depends on your field, budget, and merit — compare the details above.

What is the fee difference between UET Taxila and UHS?

UET Taxila's fee is approximately Rs. 30–50K/sem per semester, while UHS's is Rs. 30–60K/sem. See the full comparison above.

What is the merit for UET Taxila and UHS?

UET Taxila: 60%+ FSc, ECAT. UHS: MDCAT required, 70%+.
